clusters.name: Bea's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your father working late and rarely home by November, distance opening between them; beside this, you developed stomach aches and missed school by February 1996, and your brother Jonah and father had shouting matches by May; your mother did not return to her job by September. The shifts pile up across the household as the new baby arrived and your parents' time together fell away.
